title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. dillenii
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. dillenii, commonly known as Kidney Vetch, is a flowering plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. Additionally, Kidney Vetch has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, although its efficacy for these uses requires further scientific validation.
